title: Project: Build a Semantic Article Page
summary: Build an article page with landmarks, semantic content containers, logical headings, and accessible image text.

sketchBlocks.title: Project brief: Eastside Garden Journal
sketchBlocks.bodyMarkdown:
### Project Brief

**Scenario:** The Eastside Community Center needs a clear article page about its neighborhood garden program.

**Your role:** Junior web developer preparing the story for the community website.

**Workspace:** Work in `index.html` and use the live browser preview after each meaningful change.

**Deliverable:** A semantic article page with page landmarks, navigation, article and section structure, complementary information, a logical heading hierarchy, and a meaningful image text alternative.

Build the page in three cumulative steps. Each new step starts from the exact working result of the previous one.

quizDraft.title: Add the page landmarks and navigation
quizDraft.prompt: Start the Eastside Garden Journal page by organizing it with header, nav, main, and footer. Keep the title and introduction in header, place both jump links in nav, keep the story and visit content in main, and move the contact line into footer.
quizDraft.hint: First identify the introduction, navigation, primary content, and closing information.

help.concept: Landmarks describe the purpose of major page regions.
help.hint_1: Build header and nav around the title, introduction, and two links.
help.hint_2: Place the story and visit content in main, then put the contact line in footer.

quizDraft.title: Structure the article and related content
quizDraft.prompt: Continue the same page. Wrap the garden story in article. Add a What changed section with the provided paragraph inside the article. Keep Visit the garden as its own section, and add the Related activity aside with the seed-starting workshop text.
quizDraft.hint: Use each semantic container for the relationship its content has to the page.

help.concept: Article holds the self-contained story, section groups a theme, and aside holds complementary information.
help.hint_1: Put What changed inside the article under an h3.
help.hint_2: Keep Visit the garden as a separate section and place Related activity in aside.

quizDraft.title: Finish the accessible article structure
quizDraft.prompt: Finish the article by adding a figure after the opening story paragraph. Use garden-beds.jpg with alt="Three students filling raised garden beds with soil" and add the figcaption Students prepare the new beds for spring planting. Keep the heading hierarchy h1 for the page, h2 for major regions, and h3 for What changed.
quizDraft.hint: Keep the existing semantic structure and add the image information without changing the heading levels.

help.concept: The final page combines semantic regions, logical headings, and a meaningful image text alternative.
help.hint_1: Add figure inside article after the opening paragraph.
help.hint_2: Use the exact alt and figcaption text while preserving the h1, h2, h3 hierarchy.
